name: Термоядерный Реактор Erekir

description:
This mod adds a variety of nuclear physics features, from beryllium decay to helium to a fusion reactor that can explode and completely destroy your factory! Created as an experiment to test the capabilities of neural networks, this mod was generated entirely by neural networks. The code and all logic were generated by the DeepSeek neural network, and the textures were generated using Nano Banana 2 and Seedream 5.0.
 Этот мод добавляет множество вещей из ядерной физики, от распада бериллия на гелий до термоядерного реактора, который может взорваться и полностью уничтожить ваш завод! Мод сделан ради эксперемента для проверки возможностей нейросетей, этот мод был полностью сгенерирован нейросетями. Код и вся логика были сгенерированы нейросетью DeepSeek, текстуры были сгенерированы благодаря Nano Banana 2 и Seedream 5.0.
 这款模组添加了多种核物理特性，从铍衰变到氦，再到可能爆炸并彻底摧毁你工厂的聚变反应堆！该模组最初是作为一项测试神经网络能力的实验而创建的，完全由神经网络生成。代码和所有逻辑均由 DeepSeek 神经网络生成，纹理则使用 Nano Banana 2 和 Seedream 5.0 生成

I'm too lazy to work on this mod 24/7, so don't expect frequent updates. The reason is simple: no spriters, no testers, no moral support... in short, we endure and we carry on

= = = = = О моде / About mod = = = = =

RU: Очень опасный мод, который влияет на баланс и механику игры, добавляет новый контент в виде статус эффектов и оборонительных сооружений (башен, мин и т.д.).

Рекомендуется перед установкой сделать сохранение (чтобы откатиться назад), если в случае вам не понравится то, что может сделать данный мод. И лучше в самом деле не рискуйте лишний раз и поверьте на слово: МОД. МЕНЯЕТ. МНОГОЕ.

Важно: Описание некоторых юнитов не корректно, либо и вовсе неправильное.



ENG: A highly dangerous mod that affects game balance and mechanics, adding new content in the form of status effects and defensive structures (towers, mines, etc.).


It is highly recommended to create a backup save before installation (so you can revert), in case you don't like what this mod might do. And really, it's better not to take unnecessary risks and just take our word for it: THIS MOD. CHANGES. MANY THINGS.

Important: The descriptions for some units are incorrect or entirely wrong.

- ARmOrDer

From now on, the mod goes into experimental mode - this means that the balance may not be balanced, such as a Toxopid with a Corvus, whose attack radius go far beyond 60 cells!!!!!
Nevertheless, I advise you to calm down: when the mod reaches its peak (despite my crazy plans for it, the result of which you are already watching), I will make several versions to meet the needs of as many people as possible. In the meantime, it remains to wait. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Important:

This mod does not bring anything radically new to the game, but only expands the combat functionality of existing combat units.

Please pay attention:

The mod significantly redesigns units, changes the balance and generally complicates the game. Don't forget to make a backup in case you don't like the changes that the mod itself makes.

P.S. The mod is made for ALE maps.

name: ModInfo+
author: [accent]SamielXD[]
description:
[accent]ModInfo+ v1.3 📊✨[]

Track real-time GitHub download statistics for Mindustry mods directly in-game, now with new features like search and GitHub repo access!

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🌟 [accent]What is ModInfo+?[]

ModInfo+ is a lightweight statistics viewer that connects to GitHub's API to fetch [lime]actual download counts[] for your favorite Mindustry mods. No more guessing — see exactly how popular each mod is with [cyan]real data[].

The tracker is organized into categories, displays mods in a clean interface, includes pagination, smart caching, and now lets you **search mods**, **open GitHub repos directly**, and **read repo READMEs in-game**.

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

📊 [accent]Features[]

[lime]✓[] Real-time GitHub statistics with detailed mod view
[lime]✓[] Smart 5-minute caching system
[lime]✓[] Category-based organization (My Mods, Content Mods, Tool Mods)
[lime]✓[] Paginated view (2 mods per page for zero lag)
[lime]✓[] 60-second refresh cooldown
[lime]✓[] Download counts formatted (1.2K, 3.5M, etc.)
[lime]✓[] [cyan]NEW:[] Click mod names for detailed statistics
[lime]✓[] [cyan]NEW:[] Tier system (Diamond, Gold, Silver, Bronze, Rising)
[lime]✓[] [cyan]NEW:[] Star button opens GitHub repo directly
[lime]✓[] [cyan]NEW:[] Search mods by name or owner
[lime]✓[] [cyan]NEW:[] View a mod’s README directly in-game
[lime]✓[] Star counts and release dates
[lime]✓[] Growth rate tracking (downloads/month)
[lime]✓[] Cache timer display (shows time until auto-refresh)
[lime]✓[] Color-coded status indicators
[lime]✓[] Clean, intuitive UI with navigation

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🎮 [accent]How to Use[]

1. Click the [cyan]ModInfo+[] button in the main menu
2. Select a category from the top tabs
3. Browse mods (2 per page) or use [lime]Search[]
4. [cyan]Click on any mod name[] to view detailed statistics
5. Use [lightgray]< Prev[] and [lightgray]Next >[] to navigate
6. Click the [yellow]Star[] button to open the mod's GitHub repo
7. Click [lime]View README[] to read the mod’s README in-game
8. Hit [accent]Refresh[] to update stats (1-minute cooldown)
9. Watch the cache timer count down until auto-refresh

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

📦 [accent]Currently Tracked[]

[cyan]⭐ My Mods (3)[]
- Unit Namer Mod
- Shop System Mod
- ModInfo+ Mod

[lime]📚 Content Mods (8)[]
- The Infestations
- Astralis
- Lovecraftian Library
- Thermal Engineering
- Rusted Dunes
- Echo Fleet
- Arikoth
- More Defences

[yellow]🛠️ Tool Mods (2)[]
- Mod Tools
- HJSON++

[accent]Total: 13 mods tracked across 3 categories![]

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🏆 [accent]Tier System[]

Click any mod to see its tier badge based on downloads:

[sky]💎 Diamond Tier[] - 10,000+ downloads
[yellow]⭐ Gold Tier[] - 5,000+ downloads
[lightgray]⭐ Silver Tier[] - 1,000+ downloads
[orange]⭐ Bronze Tier[] - 500+ downloads
[white]🛡️ Rising Star[] - Under 500 downloads

Each tier represents the mod's popularity and success!

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

📊 [accent]Detailed Statistics View[]

Click any mod name to see:

[cyan]Basic Stats:[]
- [lime]Total downloads[] (formatted)
- [cyan]Release count[] (all versions)
- [yellow]Star count[] (GitHub stars)

[cyan]Timeline:[]
- [lightgray]Latest release date[]
- [lightgray]First release date[]

[cyan]Growth Metrics:[]
- [accent]Downloads per month[] (estimated growth rate)
- Based on time since first release

[cyan]Tier Badge:[]
- Visual tier indicator with icon
- Color-coded by achievement level

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

📢 [accent]Help Expand the List![]

This mod is [scarlet]community-driven[]. Want to add a mod?

[cyan]How to suggest a mod:[]
- Contact me on Discord: [lime]samielkun[]
- Open a GitHub issue with the repo link
- Format: [lightgray]owner/repo[] (e.g., SamielXD/UnitNamerMod)

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🔍 [accent]How It Works[]

ModInfo+ connects to the [cyan]GitHub API[] and fetches:
- All releases for each tracked mod
- Download counts for each release asset
- Repository information (stars, dates)
- Total downloads across all versions

[yellow]Smart Caching System:[]
- Stats cached for [lime]5 minutes[] per mod
- Displays time remaining until refresh
- Reduces API calls and improves performance
- Manual refresh available with 60-second cooldown

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

⚠️ [accent]Important Notes[]

[yellow]Accuracy Disclaimer:[]
Some mod info may be inaccurate due to:
- Incorrect or outdated repo links
- Typos in owner/repo names
- Forks instead of main repos
- Private or deleted repositories
- [scarlet]Some mods may show 0 downloads or not work[] because:
- They only publish source code in releases (no downloadable files)
- No release assets attached to their releases
- Releases contain non-mod files only
- GitHub API doesn't track direct repository downloads

[yellow]Requirements:[]
- Active internet connection
- GitHub API access (token included)

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🔄 [accent]Caching & Refresh System[]

[lime]Smart Caching:[]
- Stats cached for [cyan]5 minutes[] per mod
- Cache timer displays remaining time
- Automatic refresh when cache expires
- Separate cache for each repository

[yellow]Manual Refresh:[]
- [scarlet]60-second cooldown[] between refreshes
- Clears all cached data
- Reloads dialog with fresh stats
- Shows toast notification if cooldown active

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

🎨 [accent]UI Design Updates v1.3[]

[cyan]Category Tabs[] → Switch between My Mods, Content Mods, Tool Mods
[lime]Pagination[] → 2 mods per page for smooth scrolling

[accent]━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━[]

name: yeetus's stupid mod
author: 7vector, formerly yeetus
description:
my stupid brain told me to make a mindustry mod
poorly sprited? yep
half broken? yuup
balanced? not really
untouched for years? you betcha

version beta 1: added hydrogen and oxygen (oxygen unobtainable in survival), elctrolyser, graphene infuser, graphene, graphene solar panel, graphene walls

update beta 2: added the pencil launcher, chaos plasma, chaos mixer, eruption, air compressor (oxygen is now obtainable in survival), added campain research

update beta 2.1: added the glock (on a block), tweaked eruption and pencil launcher

update beta 2.1.1 update this god-forsaken mod to work on the latest version, quite a few things are a little broken, but it functions again, and thats all I really care about

update beta 2.1.2 fix the graphite infuser because I forgot to check if it was broken (spoiler alert, it was)

name: Frozen Farlands
author: [#3bdbff]CY4N[white] & [#11d41e]Zielony Trójkąt[white]
description:
[yellow]Before you'll play this mod, let me tell you that [red]skill and patience are highly required.
[yellow]You need to learn from your mistakes and lost battles in order to complete some sectors.[white]
Welcome to the Frozen farlands,
here, where there is no such thing called heat, Serpulo's Moon Awaits you!
Zilo, a place colonized by Bushark the fraction from Tantros,
Even if that's only a moon there are many new things, new resources, blocks, units, turrets, just everything.
There is one more place we would like you to visit... Gheţar
A Lonely Asteroid orbiting behind Zilo,
Maybe it's a small place but it doesn't means it is going to be easy in there, but surely you'd be having fun...

This mod contains custom soundtracks, please do not steal them... instead get a better vibe while playing
And Thanks to [#8c0303]Świrek[white] for helping us with code.
We hope you'll enjoy our mod
This Isn't our last creation, we have a huge plans upcoming, if you are interested in our plans, concepts and updates join our discord server
Our contributtors: [#36a855]RouterXdd[white], [#327db3]Silin Veredno[white] and [#dba642]Catana8735[white]
link: [blue]https://discord.gg/TQTW3mfYyf[white]
We also have it on a disboard.

name: No Weather
